description: This file implements a voice-switching bot using Pipecat framework, with classes for managing voice states, transport setup, and bot execution logic including event handlers for client connection/disconnection.

classes.name: SwitchVoices
classes.description: A pipeline class managing voice switching logic with filters for different voices and methods to switch current voice.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SwitchVoices pipeline with predefined voice options.

methods.name: current_voice
methods.description: Property to get the current selected voice.

methods.name: switch_voice
methods.description: Asynchronously switches the current voice based on user input.

methods.name: news_lady_filter
methods.description: Filter method to check if current voice is 'News Lady'.

methods.name: british_lady_filter
methods.description: Filter method to check if current voice is 'British Lady'.

methods.name: barbershop_man_filter
methods.description: Filter method to check if current voice is 'Barbershop Man'.
